about: Named skill stacks: ordered skills that work well together for one goal, like a preset of photo filters. The stack engine offers a recipe when a task matches it, and its Markov model learns its first transitions from these sequences before any real usage exists. Every name must be a real skill; tests/test_stack.py checks this.
